items.details: Made Man requires a new campaign on Classic from beginning to ending without lowering difficulty. Clearing only the last chapter on Classic or combining Chapter Select clears does not replace that run. A gentler first playthrough followed by a separate Classic campaign is also valid. On Classic, reloading discards ammunition left in the magazine: use cover, watch flanks and reload at sensible breaks. Checkpoints allow retries; the campaign need not be completed without deaths.

details_i18n.en: Made Man requires a new campaign on Classic from beginning to ending without lowering difficulty. Clearing only the last chapter on Classic or combining Chapter Select clears does not replace that run. A gentler first playthrough followed by a separate Classic campaign is also valid. On Classic, reloading discards ammunition left in the magazine: use cover, watch flanks and reload at sensible breaks. Checkpoints allow retries; the campaign need not be completed without deaths.
details_i18n.pt: Made Man exige iniciar uma nova campanha em Classic e mantê-la até o final sem reduzir a dificuldade. Concluir só o último capítulo em Classic ou juntar capítulos pelo Chapter Select não substitui essa campanha. Também é válido jogar primeiro em uma dificuldade mais tranquila e depois iniciar outra campanha em Classic. Nesse modo, recarregar descarta a munição restante no pente: use cobertura, observe os flancos e recarregue nas pausas adequadas. Os pontos de controle permitem tentativas; não é exigida uma campanha sem mortes.

items.details: Finish the three-lap race in first place overall. Brake before tight turns, release the brake as you turn and apply acceleration gradually; sharp steering under full power can spin the car. Learn where the track narrows and avoid exchanging impacts there. A controlled corner exit is more useful than entering too fast. Restart the checkpoint to practice if necessary. During a Made Man campaign, keep Classic selected rather than lowering difficulty to bypass the race.

details_i18n.en: Finish the three-lap race in first place overall. Brake before tight turns, release the brake as you turn and apply acceleration gradually; sharp steering under full power can spin the car. Learn where the track narrows and avoid exchanging impacts there. A controlled corner exit is more useful than entering too fast. Restart the checkpoint to practice if necessary. During a Made Man campaign, keep Classic selected rather than lowering difficulty to bypass the race.
details_i18n.pt: Termine a corrida de três voltas em primeiro na classificação final. Freie antes das curvas fechadas, solte o freio ao virar e acelere gradualmente; virar bruscamente acelerando tudo pode rodar o carro. Aprenda onde a pista estreita e evite trocar batidas nesses pontos. Uma saída controlada de curva vale mais que entrar rápido demais. Reinicie o ponto de controle para praticar quando necessário. Durante uma campanha de Made Man, mantenha Classic, em vez de reduzir a dificuldade para passar da corrida.

items.details: Prioritize attackers who can damage the truck immediately. During the armored pursuit, watch the marked vulnerable points and respond as the targets change instead of shooting indefinitely at solid plating. Reload during brief gaps and avoid spending all ammunition on distant threats. Surviving the farm firefight alone does not finish the chapter; keep defending the vehicle until the moving escape sequence resolves.

details_i18n.pt: Priorize os atacantes capazes de danificar imediatamente o caminhão. Durante a perseguição blindada, observe os pontos vulneráveis marcados e responda às mudanças de alvo, em vez de atirar indefinidamente na blindagem sólida. Recarregue nas pequenas pausas e evite gastar toda a munição em ameaças distantes. Sobreviver ao tiroteio da fazenda não conclui o capítulo; continue defendendo o veículo até resolver a sequência de fuga em movimento.

items.details: The end of Election Campaign offers a story opportunity for Heat from the Cops. Break the police’s sight line, use marked escape barriers when available and hide beyond patrol sight. items.details: Treat each gallery room as a separate encounter: enter behind cover, identify immediate threats and secure a route before advancing. Watch and listen for attacks from different levels. During the final confrontation, use pauses between enemy movements to reposition and reload. Continue through the following scenes to register campaign completion. The story has a fixed ending; there is no second ending checklist to complete on the same save.

details_i18n.pt: Trate cada salão da galeria como um encontro separado: entre protegido, identifique ameaças imediatas e assegure uma rota antes de avançar. Observe e escute ataques de outros níveis. No confronto final, use as pausas entre movimentos do adversário para mudar de posição e recarregar. Continue pelas cenas seguintes para registrar a campanha. A história tem um final fixo; não existe uma segunda lista de final para concluir no mesmo arquivo.

items.details: Free Ride unlocks after chapter one, but letters and jobs also depend on story progress. Post-story cleanup is convenient. Read the pool-table letter at Salieri’s Bar and complete The Crazy Horse first, then inspect the additional notes for ten assignments. Finish all eleven before reading the final upstairs letter for Curse of the Baskervilles. Answer ringing booths without an active police chase. Alien Infiltration requires night; use the bar’s time-of-day painting if needed. These jobs are optional for the campaign, and individual phone completions do not each award a native trophy.

details_i18n.en: Free Ride unlocks after chapter one, but letters and jobs also depend on story progress. Post-story cleanup is convenient. Read the pool-table letter at Salieri’s Bar and complete The Crazy Horse first, then inspect the additional notes for ten assignments. Finish all eleven before reading the final upstairs letter for Curse of the Baskervilles. Answer ringing booths without an active police chase. Alien Infiltration requires night; use the bar’s time-of-day painting if needed. These jobs are optional for the campaign, and individual phone completions do not each award a native trophy.
details_i18n.pt: Free Ride é liberado após o primeiro capítulo, mas cartas e trabalhos também dependem do avanço da história. A limpeza depois da campanha é conveniente. Leia a carta na mesa de bilhar do bar de Salieri e conclua primeiro The Crazy Horse; depois examine os novos bilhetes para mais dez trabalhos. Termine os onze antes de ler a última carta no andar superior para Curse of the Baskervilles. Atenda às cabines sem perseguição policial ativa. Alien Infiltration exige noite; use o quadro de horário do bar se necessário. Os trabalhos são opcionais para a campanha e cada conclusão telefônica não concede um troféu nativo individual.

items.details: After the campaign, all five postcards are available on the noticeboard inside Bertone’s Autoservice. Collect them before searching: they enable the associated hidden-garage interactions. Each clue corresponds to a distinct hidden car. Enter each discovered vehicle and check the Free Ride garage afterward. Some entrances require clearing crates or dealing with a defender, so bring suitable equipment from the bar’s armory. These cars are separate from ordinary street models.

details_i18n.en: After the campaign, all five postcards are available on the noticeboard inside Bertone’s Autoservice. Collect them before searching: they enable the associated hidden-garage interactions. Each clue corresponds to a distinct hidden car. Enter each discovered vehicle and check the Free Ride garage afterward. Some entrances require clearing crates or dealing with a defender, so bring suitable equipment from the bar’s armory. These cars are separate from ordinary street models.
details_i18n.pt: Depois da campanha, os cinco cartões-postais ficam disponíveis no quadro da Bertone’s Autoservice. Pegue-os antes de procurar: eles habilitam as interações nas garagens escondidas correspondentes. Cada pista corresponde a um carro escondido diferente. Entre em cada veículo descoberto e confira depois a garagem de Free Ride. Algumas entradas exigem remover caixas ou enfrentar um defensor; leve equipamento adequado do arsenal do bar. Esses carros são separados dos modelos comuns das ruas.

items.description: Use its postcard clue to locate the hidden vehicle and add it to the garage.

description_i18n.en: Use its postcard clue to locate the hidden vehicle and add it to the garage.

items.details: Collect the corresponding postcard from Bertone first. Bring a firearm from the bar's armory and enter the waterfront warehouse indicated by the clue. Shoot the breakable crates and climb through the stacks to reach the car. To open its exit, operate the three wall switches in order: middle, left, right. Enter the Trautenberg Sport and drive out through the opened door; verify that the model is available in your Free Ride garage.

details_i18n.en: Collect the corresponding postcard from Bertone first. Bring a firearm from the bar's armory and enter the waterfront warehouse indicated by the clue. Shoot the breakable crates and climb through the stacks to reach the car. To open its exit, operate the three wall switches in order: middle, left, right. Enter the Trautenberg Sport and drive out through the opened door; verify that the model is available in your Free Ride garage.
details_i18n.pt: Pegue primeiro o cartão-postal correspondente na oficina de Bertone. Leve uma arma do arsenal do bar e entre no armazém junto à água indicado pela pista. Atire nas caixas quebráveis e atravesse as pilhas para alcançar o carro. Para abrir a saída, acione os três interruptores da parede nesta ordem: meio, esquerda, direita. Entre no Trautenberg Sport e saia pela porta aberta; confira se o modelo está disponível na garagem de Free Ride.

details_i18n.pt: Motor Museum conta modelos adicionados à garagem selecionável, não cada entrada da Carcyclopedia. Entre em novos modelos para registrá-los e confira a garagem no bar de Salieri.
